one_sentence: ISO-017 argues that a Logos field (chi) added to the Einstein field equations provides a Christological completion of general relativity without contradicting established physics.
executive_summary: ISO-017 proposes a modified Einstein field equation that includes a Logos field (chi) stress-energy term, with a coupling constant kappa ~ 10^(-69). The core claim is that this chi-field represents Christological mediation—the Logos as the underlying substrate through which physical law operates. The key evidence is that the modified equation reduces to standard general relativity in the limit chi → 0, preserving all known predictions while potentially resolving singularities and contributing to dark energy. The conclusion is that the mapping is formally valid but not experimentally distinguishable from other scalar-tensor gravity theories; its significance arises from connections within the broader Theophysics framework.
short_summary: ISO-017 is a candidate isomorphism record that maps a modified Einstein field equation with a Logos field to Christological mediation. The core structural claim is that the chi-field stress-energy term completes general relativity without contradiction, recovering GR in the limit. Key evidence includes the small coupling constant kappa ~ 10^(-69) and the formal reduction to standard equations. This matters because it attempts to ground Christology in spacetime geometry, though it fails the swap test against other scalar-tensor theories.
